Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to synthesize the definitive evidence already present in the conversation and prematurely concluded the task with an incorrect year (405) based on a misinterpretation of the search results. In Step 9, the WebSurfer successfully retrieved a Britannica snippet stating the event occurred in "405-406" and a Wikipedia snippet explicitly stating "December 31, 406". Despite this clear evidence pointing to 406 as the end year, the Planner in Step 10 incorrectly decided to resolve the date as "405" (or 405-406) and instructed the WebSurfer to continue searching for a specific "405" citation. This represents a failure to trust the authoritative sources found and an arbitrary decision to prioritize the earlier year of a range without justification, leading to the wrong final answer.
